items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Henry, he and I liked -- were so fluent at it... we jumped into it... instead of 'Walk, Johnny, Walk', why we met Bob Schafer

ctx.x: Uh hunh. Tell me about -- oh, you --

So I was gonna say, so Henry, he and I liked -- were so fluent at it, so he said, "Kid, you got any songs?" "Yeah, I got one particular one, it's 'Walk, Johnny, Walk'. And I say, "Well, I think it's going to be good." And so tomorrow afternoon we made an appointment, and we met and he said, "That sounds good.", but he said, "But nobody wants to hear no man walk." He said, "Look, let's fix this and use the same words and all that, but we'll make it into a woman, and say 'Walk, Jenny, Walk', because who's going to…
day, when we had finished and had it all straightened out and it was "Walk, Jenny, Walk", instead of "Walk, Johnny, Walk", why we met Bob Schafer, and that's how that got started.
